response.query: How can we quantitatively model detection probability and preservation bias across landscapes to test preservation/survey bias versus true absence between Asia and western Europe?
response.answer: Use occupancy models and detection-nondetection data to quantify detection probability and assess preservation bias across landscapes in Asia versus western Europe. Compare survey effort and species presence to determine true absence versus detection/survey bias. Utilize statistical methods to differentiate between preservation bias and true absence.
